content:
Just after catching AirPods Pro 3 dropping to one of the lowest prices to date, the fall Prime Day deals are starting to flood in on the latest Mac releases. We have new all-time low pricing on M6 Mac mini releases at up to nearly $150 off, and a near-$200 price drop on the 2026 Mac Studio.

Those deals also join solid $200 price drops across just about all M5 MacBook Air models, an ongoing M5 Pro MacBook Pro offer at $500 off, the first deal on Apple’s new minimalist all-glyph Magic Keyboard, and rare Magic Mouse price drops too.

For those of you looking towards the MacBook lineup, fall Prime Day is ushering in the lowest prices in months on Apple’s M5 MacBook Air lineup. Amazon is now delivering solid $200 price drops across just about every configuration it offers with several color options on just about all of them:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,399 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $1,999)

Amazon landed this morning with some seriously notable price drops on Apple’s brand-new Mac mini lineup. Including the entry-level M6 configuration right up through to the more powerful M5 Max-equipped model, we are now tracking as much as $149 off to deliver the lowest prices ever offered:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099) – All-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low

Those deals also sit alongside the lowest price to date on the new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM as Amazon has now slashed $199 off the list for the best deal we have tracked since release last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (Reg. $2,499) – All-time low

While we are still awaiting (hoping for) a more expansive collection of MacBook Pro deals, Amazon is still delivering an impressive $500 price drop on this upgraded 2TB model – this deal actually lands this model at $100 less than the pre-price hike MSRP:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (Reg. $3,199)

From there, we are also tracking some great discounts on Apple’s Mac accessories. More specifically, both the black and white Magic Mouse is now seeing some rare discounts at up to nearly 25% off the list alongside the very first discount on the brand new Magic Keyboard Apple just released with the super clean all-glyph treatment on the keys:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (NEW 2026 model) $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse white $60 (Reg. $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse black $80 (Reg. $99)
